issues.claim: b: "Общий дизайн изменения: осмысленно ли взаимодействуют его части, место ли этому коду в этой кодовой базе, ..." / "The overall design of the change: whether its parts interact sensibly, ..."
issues.problem: The correct option is much longer and more detailed than the three distractors, so a test-taker can spot it by length alone. Its wording also follows the guide's design section almost verbatim.
issues.suggestedFix: Shorten option b in both locales, e.g. "The overall design of the change: whether its parts fit together and belong in this codebase." Keep the longer wording in the answer and explanation.

issues.claim: Какую проблему дороже всего исправлять после слияния изменения, а какую можно поправить одной строкой в любой момент?
issues.problem: The hint nearly states the reasoning behind the answer (design is costly to fix, naming and style are cheap), so it is stronger than a nudge. The English hint has the same strength, so there is no RU/EN drift.
issues.suggestedFix: Soften both hints, e.g. "Which kind of problem gets harder to undo as other code is built on top of it?"

issues.claim: Daily Scrum улучшает коммуникацию, помогает выявлять препятствия и быстро принимать решения, поэтому заменяет многие другие встречи.
issues.problem: The guide says Daily Scrums "eliminate the need for other meetings". The Russian "заменяет" (replaces) shifts the meaning, since the guide does not say the Daily Scrum replaces other meetings. The English version also softens the guide's wording to "many other meetings".
issues.suggestedFix: RU: "...быстро принимать решения, поэтому избавляет от необходимости в других встречах." EN: "...so it eliminates the need for other meetings."

issues.claim: Для кого это событие и что именно на нём проверяют - работу отдельных людей или продвижение команды к общей цели?
issues.problem: The hint points straight at the Sprint Goal framing used by options a and b, so it comes close to giving the answer away. The English hint has the same strength.
issues.suggestedFix: Soften both hints, e.g. "Who owns this event, and what is it meant to inspect and adapt?"
